findingDetails.title: Permission deny-half translates three ways: runtime-enforced, prose-remembered, silent
findingDetails.evidence: allow-to-present / deny-to-absent translation verified 12/12 (context = Read,Grep,Glob in .claude and read,grep,find,ls in .pi; prompt-improver likewise; review keeps Bash not Write/Edit); the deny enforcement differs: .opencode/agents/deep-review.md:6-17 denies task/webfetch/patch/chrome_devtools at the runtime layer (the mechanism .claude/agents/code.md:40 itself documents); .claude mirrors carry instructional prose reminders (deep-review.md:80, deep-improvement.md:21); .pi mirrors carry no prose trail — the spec hint that permission mappings drop to comments is confirmed at .claude/agents/code.md:40
findingDetails.recommendation: State the deny-translation semantics per runtime in a shared README so auditors need not re-derive it
findingDetails.scopeProof: Angle 7 permission-mapping question, the exact spec wording (spec.md Angle 7; strategy section 13); the 48-block matrix backs it

findingDetails.title: Tool lexicon: three spoken dialects, no documented crosswalk, provenance marking in one of four trees
findingDetails.evidence: three spoken lexicons: .claude TitleCase CSV with delegation by Agent-tool membership (ai-council.md:4, orchestrate.md:4 only); .pi lowercase block with find+ls and no glob, systematic across all 12; .codex declares no tools (deep-review.toml:5, sandbox_mode workspace-write + prose); provenance markers only in .codex (deep-review.toml:2, Converted-from); no README in .codex/agents/ or .pi/agents/
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the two missing tree-level READMEs covering the primitive swap, delegation translation, and provenance convention; extend the Converted-from marker to the .claude and .pi trees
findingDetails.scopeProof: Angle 7 tool-vocabulary question (strategy section 13: the vocabulary the mirrors must preserve); the lexicon delta observed across all 12 .pi mirrors

findingDetails.title: Leaf contract triple-licensed: agent file, workflow, and state schema disagree on budgetProfile/edgeCases
findingDetails.evidence: the agent body, verbatim across all four trees, demands choosing and recording one budget profile (deep-review.md:167: scan 9-11, verify 11-13, adjudicate 8-10), recording edge cases (line 14) and self-certifying the JSONL matches budgetProfile and edgeCases (line 520); the dispatch layer speaks a flat band (prompt packs line 97: Target 9, soft max 12, hard max 13) with no profile concept; the pack output-contract fieldlist and the state-record required/optional lists contain neither key; iteration-001 of this lane recorded neither; verify-iteration.cjs checks neither so the gate cannot see the drift
findingDetails.recommendation: Pick one licensing: the packs adopt the profile+edgeCases vocabulary and state-jsonl.md adds the optional keys, or the agent checklist drops the self-certification; rated P2 impact-based, borderline P1 noted
findingDetails.scopeProof: The contract split binds this very lane (the pack restates the workflow agent block); the state schema reference is the deep-review contract; all inside system-deep-loop

findingDetails.title: Model attraction structurally unowned: three trees silent, the fourth pins gpt-5.5
findingDetails.evidence: no .opencode, .claude or .pi agent file declares a model (frontmatter census, 36 files); the whole-file grep for opus over .opencode/agents/deep-review.md returned zero hits, so the runs-model-opus property lives in the workflow dispatch configuration, not any agent artifact; .codex/agents/deep-review.toml:6-7 = model gpt-5.5 + reasoning effort high; dispatched routes override at dispatch time so the promise holds there; direct invocation inherits the runtime default, undocumented as needing agreement
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the honest fallback model to the three silent trees or one doctrine line that model parity is dispatch-enforced only
findingDetails.scopeProof: Angle 7 cross-runtime vocabulary question; the TOML pin vs the three silences is the parity gap; system-deep-loop plus the runner
